observations.code_quote: "description": "Open pull requests plus any merged or closed within the window, newest first, each with its head-SHA CI rollup (runs / passing / failing / pending). Use this for \"which PRs are stuck\", \"which open PRs have failing or pending CI\", and per-author or per-repo PR triage. open_to_merge_seconds is coarse — it is merged_at minus created_at and fuses draft and ready-for-review time, so report it as \"open to merge\", never \"cycle time\". ready_to_merge_seconds is the true cycle time: merged_at minus the last observed ready-for-review transition (only the last draft/ready switch counts), or minus created_at for a merged PR verifiably never drafted. Null means \"not observed\" (the issue-events window is bounded), never zero. CI counts come from the latest run per workflow on the head SHA and can lag until the workflow_run webhook settles a late completion. Bots and drafts are present; exclude them (is_bot, is_draft) for throughput questions.",
